actions.script:
import java.time.LocalDate def now = LocalDate.now() def fysSetting = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.base.CompanySettings").condition("organizationPartyId", ec.user.getPreference("ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION")).condition("settingKey", "FY_START_MONTH").one() int fyStartMonth = fysSetting ? (fysSetting.settingValue as int) : 4 int fyStart = now.monthValue >= fyStartMonth ? now.year : now.year - 1 String fySuffix = String.format("%02d-%02d", fyStart % 100, (fyStart + 1) % 100)
def last = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.maintenance.Equipment") .condition("equipmentNumber", "like", "EQ/${fySuffix}/%").orderBy("-equipmentNumber").limit(1).list() int nextSeq = 1 if (last) { def parts = last[0].equipmentNumber.split("/") if (parts.length == 3) nextSeq = (parts[2] as int) + 1 } String equipmentNumber = "EQ/${fySuffix}/" + String.format("%05d", nextSeq)
context.equipmentId = ec.entity.sequencedIdPrimary("zenith.erp.maintenance.Equipment", null, null) ec.entity.makeValue("zenith.erp.maintenance.Equipment").setAll([ equipmentId: context.equipmentId, equipmentNumber: equipmentNumber, equipmentName: equipmentName, equipmentType: equipmentType, make: make, model: model, serialNumber: serialNumber, facilityId: facilityId, locationDetail: locationDetail, purchaseDate: purchaseDate, purchaseAmount: purchaseAmount, warrantyExpiryDate: warrantyExpiryDate, statusId: "EqActive", currentMeterReading: 0, meterUnit: meterUnit ?: "Hours", criticality: criticality ?: "Medium", description: description ]).create()

def existing = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.maintenance.WorkOrderPart") .condition("workOrderId", workOrderId).orderBy("-partSeqId").limit(1).list() int nextSeq = 1 if (existing) nextSeq = (existing[0].partSeqId as int) + 1
def totalCost = ((quantityUsed ?: quantityRequired ?: 0) as BigDecimal) * ((unitCost ?: 0) as BigDecimal) ec.entity.makeValue("zenith.erp.maintenance.WorkOrderPart").setAll([ workOrderId: workOrderId, partSeqId: String.format("%05d", nextSeq), productId: productId, partName: partName, quantityRequired: quantityRequired, quantityUsed: quantityUsed, unitCost: unitCost, totalCost: totalCost ]).create()
